title: Pokemon TCG Japanese 151 Starmie Holo 121/165 Card
categoryName: Toys & Hobbies:Collectible Card Games:CCG Individual Cards
descriptionText:
This rare and highly sought-after Pokémon TCG card features the powerful Water and Psychic type Starmie in stunning holo finish. With a card size of standard and a weak defense of Lx2 / Resist: 0 / Retreat: 1, this Stage 1 card is a valuable addition to any collection. 

The card is from the 151 set, manufactured by Nintendo in Japan and illustrated by Arai Kirika. It has a card number of 121/165 and is a Holo Rare with a Speed Attack cost of Wx1; 1. The card's language is Japanese and it is made of high-quality card stock material. Perfect for fans of the Pokémon TCG game, this card is a must-have for collectors and players alike.
